name: Explicit Radiance Fields
aliases: Explicit Radiance Fields Reconstruction via Gauss-Newton
definition: A method for image-based 3D reconstruction of 360° scenes that formulates volumetric reconstruction as a non-linear least-squares problem solved explicitly without neural networks, using a voxel grid and hierarchical environment maps.
summary: Explicit Radiance Fields reconstruct 3D scenes using a voxel grid and environment maps via Gauss-Newton optimization, achieving significantly faster convergence than neural methods.
